listing.name: WipEout / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Unpack the v0.1.4 setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Windows, follow the kit instructions for Python and build tools. On Linux, use a native C/C++ compiler, CMake, Ninja, Python 3.10 or newer, OpenGL and zlib.

steps.title: Prepare Mac tools
steps.instruction: Choose the official v0.1.4 ZIP for your Intel or Apple silicon Mac and unpack it into a writable folder. Put Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3.10 or newer on PATH. The bundled game and BIOS generators require macOS 15 or newer.

steps.title: Supply your matching disc and BIOS
steps.instruction: Use your own European WipEout disc (SCES-00010) with all 12 tracks present. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-5552 BIOS dump. Keep the CUE and every referenced track together when using CUE/BIN.

steps.title: Build and add the player
steps.instruction: Run WipEout_Recompiled (with .exe on Windows) and follow Generate & Build. Select the completed player under build-release and use build-release as the start folder.

warnings: The publisher reports that the kit’s recorded data track differs from the current Redump digest. If the setup tool rejects your disc, stop and check the upstream notes before trying another input.
The kit records known BIOS-stage audio and FMV placement defects. Portcove has not verified gameplay or native setup for this kit.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Keep the complete working folder and back up your disc image, BIOS, saves, settings and overlay captures before replacing the kit. Keep the player with the folder that built it.
